notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from governmental funds statement (p4) Total Governmental Funds column; debt service principal and interest are printed under Other Financing Sources (Uses) after total expenditures, so recorded as disbursements with outside_printed_total. Operating transfers in 576,561.23 is a net figure printed 'in (out)'. beginning_cash null (not shown). ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash plus cash held by County Treasurer (p3); certificates of deposit 3,714,289.43 in ending_investments. Business-type from proprietary statement p6-7 total column; receipts/disbursements totals computed (no single printed total). Balance sheet uses government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), Governmental and Business-Type Activities columns. Gov expenditures are listed by object; statement-level functions guessed by the larger fund column. Statement 'Capital outlay' 2,812,635.59 (General 2,552,852.71 + Street 259,782.88) relabelled Capital Outlay: General Government (larger column). Proprietary cash flow reconciliation (p9) adds nothing new. Detail (user 2026-10-27): the only supplementary schedule is the all-funds budgetary schedule (p10), so detail is one line per individual fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4) and proprietary funds statement (p6-7); the combined p10 schedule lines are not used. Detail object lines take their fund's function (General Fund -> general government unless the line is a function; Street Fund -> streets/highways; Community Development -> economic development). Attempt 3 (2026-10-28): business-type Charge for services -> Utility Charges (statement and Billing Fund detail); General Fund Fuel/Repairs/Salaries detail -> general government; Street Fund Meetings/Payroll/Supplies/Utilities detail -> streets/highways; Community Development Supplies -> economic development; Due from funds -> Internal Balances; Sales and use taxes -> Sales and Use Tax; capital outlay lines relabelled.
